answer: Anchor trust in slashing: every verifier posts a bond on-ledger, and if it countersigns an invalid transaction, an automated fraud-proof claim burns that bond, with the burn sized well above a full epoch of rewards. Identities are cheap to mint, but honest-work stakes are not, so fake identities earn nothing and risk everything.
